text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Posted in the thread on your message in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Your first report was 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant." The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard in the meantime. Both lanes were working again by 11:07.

SUP-5380 also has an 08:12 entry saying the connection had failed and drivers were queueing. It doesn't name an author, so you'll want to check the ticket before deciding whether that's the first-report time.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: @Ruth Calloway, the channel says the screenshot is attached to ticket INC-4821. That's Gideon's 11:08 AM message on 3 Aug. I searched the brain and found no separate page for INC-4821, so I can't confirm the attachment from the ticket itself.
